scope: GTK 3.24.41, WebKitGTK API 4.1 runtime 2.52.6, private X11/Xvfb, forced font DPI 96/144/192, GDK_SCALE 1/2, GDK_DPI_SCALE=1
hypothesis: GTK font-DPI FromDIP inflates embedded webview hosts while WebKit CSS-to-host scale stays unchanged
result: WebKit already applies font DPI to CSS-to-device mapping at default page zoom 1.0. FromDIP(224), FromDIP(64), and FromDIP(560) expose 224, 64, and 560 CSS px at every tested configuration.
proposed_extra_zoom: Rejected: page zoom 1.5 at 144 DPI reduces a matching 336-user-unit host to innerWidth 149 CSS px and causes the expanded synthetic menu to enter its compact breakpoint. At 192 DPI page zoom 2 reduces matching 448-user-unit host to 112 CSS px.
smallest_app_correction: None: keep FromDIP sizing and existing zoom behavior. Optionally correct DeviceWebHost.cpp comment to call SetMinSize dimensions wx window coordinates rather than physical pixels on GTK.
limits: Synthetic native GTK host matching pinned wx sizing, not full Bambu Home execution
No real desktop XSettings normalization or Wayland coverage
No older WebKit or Windows/macOS coverage
Installed headers/GIR and actual runtime used; full WebKit implementation source unavailable locally
